behavior: Explicit collector URL/headers/CA identity do not inherit ambient collector endpoints, credentials, certificates or HTTP proxy settings. Only supported timeout/compression environment defaults are merged.

Session SDK User-Agent, gzip payloads, per-attempt async headers, retryable HTTP/network failures, Retry-After/deadline behavior, response size refusal and malformed/truncated successful responses match observed Source cases.

HTTPS supports explicit CA, rejectUnauthorized, client PEM certificate/key, ciphers and TLS version bounds. A protocol-selected Python agent factory supplies an SSLContext or an object exposing ssl_context; PEM identity loader files are removed immediately after loading.

Agent/header callback exceptions bypass network retry even when carrying a retryable OS error. Export admission is bounded; owned shutdown drains in-flight work independently of Python waiter cancellation.
limitations: Python transport does not reproduce Node Agent socket pooling or its arbitrary options/Agent ABI. PFX and custom Node checkServerIdentity callbacks are not implemented. Wire framing, connection reuse and platform-specific TLS error text are not parity claims.
Ordinary-event cancellable HTTP/batching, otel service activation and session backend integration remain follow-up work; the historical production backend is not yet replaced.
Full migration/release, actual Portable/browser and Windows 7 qualification remain pending.
